chip.description: Mitsubishi M37702 microcontroller with 16 KB of on-die mask ROM, relabelled by Namco as the C74 and used on Namco System 22 hardware.
chip.notes: src/mame/namco/namcomcu.cpp in MAME 0.288 ("Mitsubishi M37702 MCUs with Namco custom labels"), with the label-to-system table and a 0x4000-byte internal ROM region per part. Filed mcu under taxonomy TB2 (on-die program store plus integrated peripherals).
